reasoning_content: The build log seems corrupted? wc -l returned the error text. Weird. Something's wrong with docker now. Let me check docker status.

action.command: docker info 2>&1 | head -5; echo "EXIT=$?"; docker ps 2>&1 | head; cat /tmp/build.log | wc -l
